decision: reject_and_revert: paired timing and instruction counts show no measurable benefit

binding_time.hypothesis: For an ordinary dense array with a present integer-indexed element, load the element before checking for an indexed accessor descriptor.
binding_time.candidate_guard: The fast return was limited to a nonnegative integer key, Cell::Array, an in-bounds present element, and a non-DELETED value; typed arrays remained ahead of this path and holes/descriptors retained the existing fallback.
binding_time.reduction: Reorder an existing dense element load and descriptor probe. No new cache, metadata, or semantic rule was introduced.

source.candidate_delta: For present dense Cell::Array values, return before array_descriptor(); retain descriptor fallback for missing/deleted values.

build.command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo build --locked --profile production -p quench-node --bin quench-node
build.note: The baseline binary was rebuilt from the committed source; the candidate binary was built with only the owner-file reorder above. Both were compared in the same alternating run.

input.source: function f(a){var total=0; for(var t=0;t<4000;t++) for(var i=0;i<2500;i++) total+=a[i]; return total;} var a=[]; for(var k=0;k<2500;k++) a.push(1); if(f(a)!==10000000) throw new Error("read result");
input.warmup: none; each timed process constructs its array before the loop

measurement.order: alternating baseline/candidate and candidate/baseline by pair

bootstrap.method: paired percentile bootstrap of the median paired delta

measurement.conclusion: The time and instruction intervals include zero. Retire the candidate; the measurement does not support a performance claim or retaining the source change.
measurement.scope_limit: This diagnostic microbenchmark is not a V8-v7 Score gate or cross-engine qualification.

candidate_test262.note: These checks establish no observed regression in the affected slices; they do not change the performance rejection.

verification.profile: Supporting source samples showed array_descriptor was a small share of the read path; profile-aggregate output was inconsistent and was not used in the decision.
